[[File:Metallic_spikes_SWNES.jpg|thumb|250px|Metallic spikes on the Death Star]]
'''Metallic spikes''' were a security measure used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="SWNES">[[Star Wars (1991 video game)|''Star Wars'' video game (1991)]]</ref> The Death Star included several of them throughout the station, with some not only being on the ground, but also on the ceilings and even directly on the walls.<ref name="Hint Book">''[[Star Wars Hint Book]]''</ref>

During Luke Skywalker and Han Solo's [[Rescue of Princess Leia/Legends|rescue]] of the Rebel leader [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] from the battle station, they encountered several of these traps.<ref name="SWNES" />
